{{- /* Images: root-relative paths ("/images/...") resolve against the site, and a missing file under static/ fails the build. */ -}} {{- $src := .Destination }} {{- $u := urls.Parse $src }} {{- if and (not $u.IsAbs) (strings.HasPrefix $src "/") }} {{- if not (fileExists (printf "static%s" $src)) }}{{ errorf "%s: image %q not found" .Page.File.Path $src }}{{ end }} {{- $src = relURL (strings.TrimPrefix "/" $src) }} {{- end -}} {{- /* chomp trailing newline */ -}}
